message.content:
## Review findings (1920px, hero card) **1) Pill row — NOT clean. Two problems:** - **Same row, but essentially no gap.** The pill ("Tidak perlu sempurna — satu habit saja sudah cukup untuk mulai") ends at roughly x≈844px and the link "Lihat perjalanan pohonmu →" starts at roughly x≈861px. That's only **~15–20px of visual separation**, and it's entirely incidental — the link is not vertically aligned with the pill's text either (it sits at the pill's vertical center, but since the pill is two lines tall it reads as floating). They read as touching/crowded at a glance. - **Pill text is clipped.** The pill's copy wraps to a second line ("mulai.") which is cut off — it's hidden behind/overlapped by the white "0% Habit hari ini" progress card sitting directly below it. So the pill is also suffering a **vertical overlap**, not just horizontal crowding. **2) Overall hero composition at 1920px:** - Headline "Langkah pertama menunggumu 🌱" — fine, good hierarchy and spacing. - Illustration on the right — fine, well placed, doesn't collide with text content. - Progress card (0% / Habit hari ini / 3 ritual...) — fine on its own, but it's the element **causing the pill clipping** (likely negative margin or the pill having fixed height / overflow hidden). - Row alignment: label "KEBUN KECILMU" and spacing above/below are consistent. So the composition is acceptable **except** for the pill/link row. ## Recommended fix Put the pill and the link in one flex row with an explicit gap and let the pill size to content: ```html
Tidak perlu sempurna — satu habit saja sudah cukup untuk mulai. Lihat perjalanan pohonmu →
``` Key points: `gap-6` (24px) instead of relying on the accidental ~16px, `items-center` for true vertical alignment, no fixed height on the pill (removes the clipping), and keep the link `whitespace-nowrap` so it never wraps into the pill. **Verdict:** same row but with an inadequate ~15–20px gap plus a clipped pill; one flex-row fix resolves both.

They appear adjacent with tiny gap. Also the white card with 0% overlaps the pill's bottom ("mulai." is cut off behind card). So answer: (1) they are on same row but with minimal/insufficient gap, and the pill text is truncated/overlapped by the progress card below. (2) hero composition mostly OK but that row has issues.
